description: Ministry of Power, Energy & Business Development - Order to acquire the land in Matthala,  Niyagama D/S Division, Galle District by Ceylon Electricity Board
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It specifically authorizes the acquisition of described lands by the Ceylon Electricity Board, provides detailed descriptions of the land plots (including location, boundaries, extent, and survey plan numbers), and identifies the current land claimant. While it mentions a government minister (Ravi Karunanayake) and his portfolio, the core content focuses entirely on land/property matters rather than government personnel changes or structural modifications, making it a Land Gazette under Type 4.
